world_to_odom_convention: Do not reuse a pitched world-to-odom anchor with planar odometry across translation. The pitch rotates odometry x displacement into a false world-z shift. Capture-time Gazebo world_from_base_link is now recorded per sample and is the supported geometry input.
motion_stop_verified: The second capture followed a 0.231 m physical x translation; explicit zero-velocity commands were sent and odometry reported zero velocity.
limitations: This check is retained as an audit record, not a passing validation. Its reused pitched anchor produces about 7 mm false height error after 0.1195 m planar translation and 13.5 mm after 0.231 m. Do not use these results as projection or label qualification. See capture-pilot-v2 for the corrected per-capture direct-pose pilot; it remains development-only and unqualified.
